install_transforms.note: emulated upstream install-time transformers for this config (packages/registry/src/utils/transformers)
install_transforms.menu: transform-menu.ts - menuColor=default removes cn-menu-target AND cn-menu-translucent (they are placeholders; only *-translucent inline the translucent classes, inverted* swaps cn-menu-target->'dark')
install_transforms.rtl: transform-rtl.ts - rtl=false -> skipped (no direction/logical-side transform, cn-rtl-flip markers absent)
install_transforms.font: transform-font.ts - cn-font-heading kept; --font-heading: var(--font-sans) present in gallery.css -> resolves to sans (no distinct heading font; Geist->Segoe deviation)
install_transforms.icons: transform-icons.ts - iconLibrary=lucide -> no-op (source paths already lucide)
install_transforms.cleanup: transform-cleanup.ts - strips transient cn-* markers only (cn-rtl-flip, cn-logical-sides); recipe cn-* classes retained

font.canonical: Segoe UI Variable (deviation from upstream Geist - deliberate rust-ui substitution)
font.css_stack: "Segoe UI Variable Text", "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif
font.font_optical_sizing: auto (DirectWrite must apply opsz by size)
font.proof: CDP CSS.getPlatformFontsForNode on every text-bearing contract element

capture_platform.deterministic: fixed viewport/dpr/zoom; animations+transitions disabled; caret hidden; no timestamps/randomness/network

devctl_bridge: automation ids == future rust-ui .automation_id(...) == UIA AutomationId; future rust-ui-devctl rect/hover/click/focus/type/snapshot-layout/compare consume contract.json
